title: [Taiwan News] Startup Island Taiwan podcast, ITRI partnership and PQC Standardization & Migration Workshop
summary: BTQ received coverage by Taiwan News highlighting our recent podcast episode on Startup Island, our ITRI partnership, and our upcoming PQC Standardization & Migration workshop in December. Read the full article here.
body_markdown:
[Back to newsroom](https://www.btq.com/news)


BTQ received coverage by Taiwan News highlighting our recent[podcast episode on Startup Island](https://podcasts.apple.com/ca/podcast/taiwans-semiconductor-strength-might-lead-the-island/id1648273735?i=1000583416300) , our[ITRI partnership](https://thequantuminsider.com/2022/09/07/btq-itri-announce-collaboration-to-develop-next-generation-semiconductor-technology-for-post-quantum-cryptography/) , and our upcoming[PQC Standardization & Migration](https://events.btq.li/pqc-workshop-2022/) workshop in December. Read the full article[here](https://www.taiwannews.com.tw/en/news/4729469) .
